name: RadialDamageData
lifetime: Lua wrapper is mutable before dispatch; retention after RadialDamage is unproven
notes: Creates the outgoing radial-damage packet used by Mallet.

name: IsNull
lifetime: No lifetime ownership; null test only
notes: Use before dereferencing borrowed engine objects.

name: UpgradedValue
lifetime: Temporary value wrapper; post-dispatch retention unproven
notes: Accepted by RadialDamageData:SetBaseAmount in stock Mallet.

name: SetSource
lifetime: Packet-local reference valid for dispatch
notes: Source attribution field.

name: SetOrigin
lifetime: Value copied or retained for dispatch; exact ownership unproven
notes: Mallet supplies its pulse origin.

name: SetBaseAmount
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Configures attempted radial damage before per-target application.

name: SetDamagePct
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet uses damage type 7 at fraction 1.

name: SetSourceObject
lifetime: Borrowed source-object reference for dispatch
notes: Do not use Lua wrapper identity as a universal hit discriminator.

name: SetDamageCallback
lifetime: Closure retained by packet at least through RadialDamage dispatch; post-dispatch lifetime unproven
notes: Second callback argument is numeric. First argument remains deliberately unknown. Callback may run multiple times for one radial dispatch.

name: RadialDamage
lifetime: Consumes or reads packet during dispatch; asynchronous retention unproven
notes: Engine owns victim selection and the complete Mallet pulse radius.

name: DamageControl
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned handle; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: Used to read and update caster Overguard.

name: GetOverguardAmount
lifetime: Value result; receiver is engine-owned
notes: Returns the current Overguard amount observed by the script.

name: SetOverguardAmount
lifetime: Receiver is borrowed; write applies to current avatar state
notes: Absolute setter, not an additive grant. Clamp and preserve larger pre-existing pools in Lua.

name: GetPlayer
lifetime: Opaque borrowed handle; exact concrete type unresolved
notes: Only the composition GetPlayer -> NotifyOverguardGain argument 1 is confirmed.

name: NotifyOverguardGain
lifetime: Arguments consumed during call; retention unproven
notes: Pass the positive delta, not the new absolute pool value.

name: AddModifiers
lifetime: Mutates temporary UpgradedValue
notes: Stock Mallet applies its modifier table before SetBaseAmount.

name: GetLocalizeTag
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned tag wrapper; consume immediately
notes: The target addon uses the returned tag only to match the currently queried ability.

name: c_str
lifetime: String value is consumed during the current comparison
notes: Confirmed only as the immediate GetLocalizeTag to c_str comparison used by the Mallet matcher.

name: ModifyValue
lifetime: Mutates the temporary UpgradedValue; engine objects are borrowed
notes: The four-argument shape is confirmed for this Mallet path. Selector 10 remains scope-bound and is not a universal Strength enum.

name: radius
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Outer radial pulse radius; not equivalent to a Lua FindAll snapshot centered on the Mallet ball.

name: horizontalImpulse
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet value is 100 in the inspected build.

name: verticalImpulse
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet value is 33.333333333333336 in the inspected build.

name: ignoreEntity
lifetime: Borrowed packet reference
notes: Entity excluded by the stock packet.

name: checkForCover
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets true.

name: staticCoverOnly
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets true.

name: fallOff
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets zero in the inspected path.
